answer: A pre-selected opt-out consent form is invalid because consent must be a specific, freely-given, plainly-worded, and unambiguous affirmation given by the data subject. If the consent is structured as an opt-out selected by default, it does not meet the requirement of being unambiguously affirmed by the user. Additionally, users must be allowed to withdraw their consent at any time, and the process of doing so must not be harder than it was to opt in.
